description: React with one emoji to a message of this line (incoming or sent) in a Telegram chat; emoji null removes the reaction. Nothing new is sent. Only the cable that holds the line's lease can react.

emoji.description: One reaction emoji Telegram allows (e.g. 👍); null or empty removes the reaction.

message_id.description: message_id of an incoming or sent message of this line (Telegram).

name: line_react
